smartStart.label: Skip Welcome
smartStart.body: When enabled, opens List if there are products; if the List is empty, opens Add.

user.title: User
user.intro: These preferences stay on this phone.

account.title: Account and password
account.body: The app does not have user login yet. To manage passwords safely, the next step is to connect authentication, for example Supabase Auth, and then show change password, sign out, and account recovery here.

family.title: Family sharing
family.connectedBody: Using code {{code}}. Every phone with this code shares the same list.
family.disconnectedBody: Configure Supabase to enable sharing between phones. The code is ready for when sync is connected.
family.useButtonHint: Applies this code to family sharing.

voice.label: Voice search
voice.body: Shows the microphone in List and Add and uses PT-pt.

store.title: Store
store.intro: Active store: {{name}}. Choose this phone's default store.

about.title: About this app
about.body: Smart Shoppingcart helps prepare the family list, add products, organize the cart by store order, and learn supermarket routes.
